description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the Land Acquisition Balapitiya D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It details specific land parcels being acquired, including their names, plan numbers, lot numbers, extents, locations, and compensation amounts. The content falls squarely under land and property-related matters, specifically land acquisitions, which is the defining characteristic of Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
